about: Representative tasks for comparing what a task needs to read (tools/context/README.md "Task routes"). before: the bounded old-doc sections at the revision `before` that answer the question (not the whole manual; what the old instructions told everyone to read first is reported apart); after: the route now, from the documentation map. A section is a heading's text (to the next heading of its level or above); no section = the whole file. fact: words that answer the question; they must be in the route's text, so a move that drops the answer fails (the after side in CI, the before side wherever the revision is in the history). agentGuide: the Discord agent's media guide the task also needs, if any. Claude and Codex follow the same route from their own entry file.
